name: services/housing/dormroom_types
description: Get information on multiple dormroom types
brief_description: Get information on multiple dormroom types

arguments.name: dormroom_type_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of dormroom type IDs

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of dormroom_type method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your dormroom_type_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain a dormroom_type object, or null, if no dormroom_type by given ID was found.
